verdict.rationale: Archived docs described service tokens that limit an agent to listing and calling tools on specific connections, which was connection-level scoping without any evidence of per-tool allowlists. Smithery's own shutdown notice says the API, Connect, Toolbox, accounts and API keys stopped working on October 31, 2026, leaving only a non-proxied public registry. Nothing remains that can restrict an agent's server or tool calls.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can restrict which servers and individual tools an agent may call through allowlists or per-tool access control
